final_message: Fixed two causes: nested formatters skipped default parsing, leaving characters unquoted, and temporary range elements were passed as rvalues to mutable-only formatters. The fix initializes nested defaults and binds each element as an lvalue before formatting. Added regression coverage; range tests pass in C++11, C++20, and C++23.
